title: SiteProfile
$comment: v1.1. A user's own signed-in session on a site (ADR 0007, ADR 0012): GET /sites/profiles. The session itself is a secret and never leaves the server.

site.description: The site key: github or gitea, or the site's origin for any other site, e.g. https://www.openstreetmap.org (ADR 0012).

account.description: The account name the user signed in as.

expires_at.description: When the session's sign-in cookie expires, if known.

sign_in_hosts.description: Other hosts (host[:port]) the owner opened while signing in, e.g. an identity provider. Later takeovers on this site may open them too (ADR 0012).

SiteSignInRequest.title: SiteSignInRequest
SiteSignInRequest.description: POST /sites/sign-in: sign in by hand to any public site, in a takeover (ADR 0012).

url.description: Any page of the site; its origin is the site.

terms_ok.description: The owner confirms the site's terms allow automated use of their account.
